## Changes: * #2794: Add dummy action to checkout the PR from session toolbar * #2971: Set delays to 0 * #2970: Include diagnostics into completion prompt * #2973: nes: joint: initial support for NES change hint * #2972: Background - fix issue with background agent that adds a file * #2969: chore: update config expiration date * #2968: Advances fake timers in small increments * #2964: refactor: remove unused IConfigurationService from TodoListContextPrompt * #2963: Add experimental setting to skip including the summarized contents of attachments * #2962: feat: add PlanModeHook tests and improve session state handling
See More * #2957: Support retrying 5xx errors * #2959: Disable linkification for subagents * #2958: fix: flush linkifier before thinking blocks in Messages API * #2956: Improve state handling of model and permission mode and react to Enter & Exit Plan mode tools * #2955: Add a CLAUDE.md * #2954: Remove WebSearch tool * #2952: fix: extend model resolution to include 'claude-opus-4-5' * #2953: fix: temporarily disable Messages API for Sonnet models * #2947: fix - update label for `deleteAgentSession` command * #2937: feat: add AskQuestions tool for agent clarifications * #2938: Prototype for model router with retry logic * #2941: add icons to cloud agent optionGroups * #2935: Fix MCP tools with nullable parameters for Gemini models * #2939: Use Terminal confirmation instead of general confirmation for bash tool * #2934: Hook up PermissionMode to an option * #2903: Remove unwanted logging from BG agent * #2927: Fix hanging when you hit stop * #2931: Refactor Anthropic context editing and tool search handling; streamline related checks and configurations * #2930: Add retries on external ingest document upload * #2928: Remove searchSubagent from top-level of tool picker * #2909: skip tool grouping when using tool search tool for anthropic models * #2900: Improved out of quota response * #2923: nes: let core know if an edit from cursor jump * #2922: Update built-in plan mode to latest tool names * #2920: Make "Start Implementation" actually start the implementation * #2919: Add issuedTime and timeToComplete to all events * #2917: nes: logs: add trace diagram * #2879: logService: feat: allow creating sub-loggers This list of changes was [auto generated](https://dev.azure.com/monacotools/Monaco/_build/results?buildId=393902&view=logs).
